audit.interpretation: bounded audit disagreement counts, not accuracy estimates; already-windowed archive bodies were excluded because their original middle cannot be audited
audit.selection: up to two raw, pre-envelope overflow bodies per frozen class: one C2 completion with most C1-hole direct signal where available plus largest fail-open; otherwise two largest fail-open bodies

completion_and_density_footnote.note: footnote only; completion count and density do not choose a contract

definitions.C1_holes: one stock middle marker per overflow body
definitions.C2_holes: one marker per contiguous K_struct run on accepted bodies; fail-open bodies are untouched stock C1
definitions.evaluation_scope: C1/C2 fidelity is evaluated only on logical pre-envelope bodies present in the archive; already-windowed Mini/DSH holes are unknown, not zero
definitions.false_completeness: structural check for unmarked source continuation; both contracts expose every omission with a marker and traverse through the original end
definitions.neighborhood: retention of the original immediate physical-line neighbors
definitions.newly_visible_line: a direct fail/hunk line wholly inside C1's hole and retained by an accepted C2 document
definitions.subsequence: source projection after removing explicit markers is a Unicode code-point subsequence of the original

false_completeness.note: marker presence is necessary, not a semantic readability judgment

method.C1_status: already shipped baseline; not a build
method.C2_contract: all classes; identity below cap; elide only complete runs in the safe K_struct subset (blank/layout, progress, exact repeats), preserving first-seen ANSI/CRLF payload; accept only if marked document <10000 code points; otherwise return C1 on the original
method.code_point_measure: Python len(str), matching production iteration/Array.from over Unicode code points
method.stock_contract: identity below 10000 logical output code points; at or above, source head 5000 + exact omitted-count marker/JSON field + source tail 5000

archive_normalization.rule: Mini identity JSON is measured from its output field. Mini output_head/output_tail JSON and valid DSH truncation-marker text are recognized as already-windowed C1; their original hole text is unavailable and is not classified or passed through C2 a second time.

real_window_census.stock_shape: C1 preserves logical source offsets [0,5000) and [chars-5000,chars), with one exact omitted-char marker between them
real_window_census.threshold_definition: overflow iff logical original Unicode code points >= 10000; identity iff < 10000

utf8_footnote.measure_note: footnote only; thresholds/headlines use logical code points, and no byte count reconstructs an unavailable stock hole
